title: GAP-001 — eBPF silently degrades without privileges: on a host lacking CAP_SYS_RESOURCE (proven 2026-08-05: `attach --pid` prints only WARN "ebpf: remove memlock rlimit failed, continuing without eBPF" / "kernel probes unavailable"), attach/serve continue and the user believes telemetry is being collected when NOTHING is. Core Collect promise broken with no hard failure. Fix: preflight privilege check at startup — explicit "eBPF unavailable — telemetry DISABLED" + non-zero exit (or documented --no-ebpf degraded mode), and README lists required privileges (CAP_SYS_RESOURCE, kernel 5.11+). PASS: on an unprivileged host, `rabbit-hole attach --pid <pid>` exits non-zero with an explicit eBPF-unavailable message (no silent continue), and README documents privilege requirements.
reasoning: PM hunter probe 2026-08-05: attach ran with WARN-only degradation, no hard error; telemetry would be empty.
